pull-request-header:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Merge the translation sync before this pull request.** Merging this pull request creates the release tag on its merge commit, so anything merged after it misses the release.
>
> 1. In Weblate, commit the pending translations (repository maintenance), so the last day of work reaches the translations repository.
> 2. Run [Sync Translations](https://github.com/CodeWithCJ/SparkyFitness/actions/workflows/sync-translations.yml) from `main` and wait for it to finish; its summary links the pull request, if one is open. If the summary shows that the translations pull request step failed, fix the cause and run it again. "Unchanged" with no pull request means there is nothing to merge, and a failure on the English pull request does not block the next step. It also runs every night.
> 3. Merge the open [chore(i18n): sync translations from Weblate](https://github.com/CodeWithCJ/SparkyFitness/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+head%3Ai18n%2Fsync-weblate-translations) pull request, if there is one, and wait for CI and Release Please on `main` to finish.
> 4. Merge this pull request and wait for its Release Please run to finish, because it rewrites the draft release. Then add the Key Highlights to the draft and publish it.
> 5. In the Actions tab, approve the waiting `release` deployments of Publish Docker Images and Build Android APK for the release you published. Release Helm Chart then starts by itself once the images are pushed: approve it after checking that its run follows that release's Publish Docker Images run. Approve nothing else.
